{{Top}}
A '''doll''' was a child's toy, usually made of [[Plasticene/Legends|plasticene]]. One doll named [[Branli]] was repaired by the [[MK 8001 Attendant Droid]] called [[Dooba]] after her finger was broken falling off a [[grav slide]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> The [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[King/Legends|king]] [[Vulgarr/Legends|Vulgarr]] showed an Ewok doll made of straw was shown to the Ewok tribe of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] when he lied to them about their children being carried off by a giant monster.<ref name="teebo">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref>
